attachments.caption: Figure 3: Overview of Long-Short Trajectory Learning. It consists of two stages, for short trajectory learning, under a given trajectory head, requires insight into the various explicit and implicit signals in each particular task. For long-trajectory learning, LLM executes the entire process by predicting different trajectory tokens, ensuring the synergism of different short-trajectories.

Methods are grouped into knowledge internalization (Alpaca2, Mistral-Instruct, Llama-2-Chat variants, Vicuna-v1.5, ChatGPT) and knowledge enhancement (Alpaca2, REPLUG, VANILLA, RAIT, INTERACT, SelfRag, MMAgent, SMART). Best results are bold, second underlined. SMART (OURS) achieves the highest on several metrics.
